title: Model lacks inherent positional information
description: Since the Transformer contains no recurrence or convolution, it has no built-in notion of token order, requiring positional encodings to be explicitly added to the input embeddings.
canonical_description: architecture lacks inherent sequence order information requiring explicit positional encoding

evidence.quote: Since our model contains no recurrence and no convolution, in order for the model to make use of the order of the sequence, we must inject some information about the relative or absolute position of the tokens in the sequence.
